title: Claude Code · Compare
description: Two sides, A and B, each a set of profiles and models: which is faster, cheaper and fails less, and by how much. Every number shows A, B and "B vs A" = (B − A) / A; green means B is better, red worse, within ±5% a draw. Rates and per-request figures are fair even when one side was used far more.
